variants.headline: Party names a new leader
variants.body: A party has a new leader in {colony}. Our verdict on {target}: not good enough, and the colony deserves a better standard of responsibility.

variants.headline: Leadership changes hands
variants.body: Leadership of a political party has changed in the colony. Our verdict on {target}: not good enough, and the colony deserves a better standard of responsibility.

variants.headline: A new name at the head of the party
variants.body: A new leader is now at the head of a party in {colony}. Our verdict on {target}: not good enough, and the colony deserves a better standard of responsibility.
